gloss_en: the dictum 'Into that which is concealed from you, do not inquire' (ba-mekhusseh mimkha al tachkor, Chagigah 13a citing Ben Sira) — the injunction against probing hidden divine matters, linked in Likutey Moharan 1:6 to concealment ('the glory of God is to conceal a matter') and to the covering firmament above which is the throne
